steps.en: Install the command pack into your agent CLI
steps.zh: 把命令包装进你的 agent CLI

steps.en: Kick off a greenfield project (or /gsd-map-codebase for existing code)
steps.zh: 新建项目起步（已有代码先 /gsd-map-codebase）

steps.en: Interview, research, and write requirements + roadmap as durable markdown under .planning/
steps.zh: 访谈、调研，把需求与路线图写成 .planning/ 下持久的 markdown

steps.en: Shape phase 1's decisions, then have it planned
steps.zh: 定下阶段 1 的实现决策，再触发规划

steps.en: Research, decompose, and verify the plan fits a fresh context window
steps.zh: 调研、拆解计划，并校验它装得进一个全新上下文窗口

component.zh: planner 与 verifier 子代理

steps.en: Parallel-wave executors each get a clean 200k-token context; every task gets its own atomic commit
steps.zh: 并行执行器各拿干净的 20 万 token 上下文，每任务独立提交

steps.en: Walk the guided UAT, then ship the verified phase
steps.zh: 走完引导式 UAT，然后交付已验证的阶段

value.en: Every phase executes in un-degraded fresh context, with an auditable commit-per-task history
value.zh: 每个阶段都在未劣化的全新上下文里执行，git 历史一任务一提交、可审计
